description: Paired seed endpoints for the two main experimental tables, including 114 new fixed-recipe fits. Accuracy vectors use percent units. Each metric lists its own paired seeds; final measurements may cover fewer seeds than the row.

pairing.original: Seed 42 + simulation index was reset before model construction for each profile in the saved notebook loops. The original arrays preserve simulation order; they do not carry explicit seed identifiers. This does not imply identical dropout masks or minibatch orders.
pairing.benchmarks: Uniform and frontloaded runs share the listed explicit seed IDs and data split within each cohort. Rows preserve that seed order.

inference: Nominal 95% paired Fieller confidence sets for percentage loss reduction (ratio of means), and paired Student-t intervals for mean accuracy gain in percentage points; degrees of freedom n-1. Independent seed pairs and approximately normal across-seed outcomes are assumed. Intervals condition on the fixed data split and selected profiles; they exclude schedule/hyperparameter/epoch-selection uncertainty and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

endpoint_definitions.original_minimum: Minimum recorded test loss separately for each seed and profile; this retrospective endpoint uses the test set to choose an epoch.
endpoint_definitions.benchmark_checkpoint: Test evaluation at each run's minimum-validation-loss checkpoint.
endpoint_definitions.benchmark_final: Last training epoch. Endpoint-specific seeds identify the available pairs: five fresh pairs where historical finals were not saved, ten for Tiny ImageNet 80k, and no final values for extended Jannis.

benchmarks.selection: Profile selected by lowest mean minimum validation loss among complete paired historical arms; retained without reselection for the new extension seeds. Each run uses its own minimum-validation-loss checkpoint.
